title: Catch-up time
description: Essential: The final answer for the time when the car catches the bicycle must be 8 seconds.

title: Car's final speed
description: Essential: The final answer for the car's speed at the catch-up moment must be 16 m/s.

title: Maximum distance
description: Essential: The final answer for the maximum separation must be 16 meters.

title: Catch-up condition
description: Important: The solution must correctly set the displacements of the car and bicycle equal to find the catch-up time.

title: Kinematic equations
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the equations for constant velocity (bicycle) and constant acceleration (car).

title: Maximum distance reasoning
description: Important: The solution must identify that maximum separation occurs when the car's speed equals the bicycle's speed.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution should include correct units (s, m/s, m) in calculations and final answers.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the bicycle's velocity as an acceleration or misassigns signs in the kinematic equations.

title: Algebraic or arithmetic mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize for errors in solving the quadratic equation for time or in calculating the maximum distance.
